ImageDescription.value: Photo taken along southbound Pennsylvania Route 512 (Main Street) approaching its intersection with Pennsylvania Avenue in Pen Argyl, Pennsylvania. PA 512 south continues west along Pennsylvania Avenue while Main Street continues ahead as SR 1024. The intersection is controlled by an unusual traffic signal with a perpetually green right arrow and a flashing red light ball. Per signage, traffic is prohibited from continuing straight onto Main Street southbound here.
